svg.title: Three optimisers, same valley, same start
svg.desc: Contour map of a long, narrow valley. Over 60 steps from the same start, plain gradient descent zig-zags and ends 1.42 from the goal, momentum ends 0.07 away, and Adam, which scales each weight's step by its own gradient history, heads almost straight for the goal and ends 0.23 away. This is an illustrative cost surface, not the MNIST network's.
svg.text: Three optimisers, same valley, same start
